title: Sparkly guitar
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE066">
    <polygon points="18,20 20,26 26,28 20,30 18,36 16,30 10,28 16,26"/>
    <polygon points="80,15 82,20 87,22 82,24 80,29 78,24 73,22 78,20"/>
    <polygon points="85,60 86,64 90,65 86,66 85,70 84,66 80,65 84,64"/>
    <polygon points="12,65 13,69 17,70 13,71 12,75 11,71 7,70 11,69"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="38" r="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="50" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="85" r="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="88" r="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Guitar neck -->
  <rect x="46" y="18" width="8" height="40" rx="2" fill="#C68B59"/>
  <!-- Neck highlight -->
  <rect x="47" y="18" width="3" height="40" rx="1" fill="#E0B07C"/>

  <!-- Frets -->
  <g stroke="#F5E6C8" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="46" y1="26" x2="54" y2="26"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="33" x2="54" y2="33"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="40" x2="54" y2="40"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="47" x2="54" y2="47"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Headstock -->
  <rect x="44" y="10" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="13" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="13" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="19" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="19" r="2" fill="#FFD700"/>

  <!-- Body - upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#E07B2A"/>
  <!-- Body - lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="26" ry="17" fill="#E07B2A"/>
  <!-- Waist connector -->
  <rect x="34" y="58" width="32" height="22" fill="#E07B2A"/>

  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#F09A4A"/>

  <!-- Sound hole -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="7" fill="#5C2E0E"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="8.5" fill="none" stroke="#F5E6C8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x="42" y="82" width="16" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5C2E0E"/>
  <rect x="42" y="82" width="16" height="1.5" rx="1" fill="#8B5E3C"/>

  <!-- Strings -->
  <g stroke="#FFF8DC" stroke-width="0.8">
    <line x1="47" y1="12" x2="47" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="49.5" y1="12" x2="49.5" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="12" x2="52" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="54" y1="12" x2="54" y2="82"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Body edge glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="26" ry="17" fill="none" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Small sparkles on body -->
  <g fill="#FFF8A0">
    <polygon points="36,74 37,77 40,78 37,79 36,82 35,79 32,78 35,77"/>
    <polygon points="64,70 65,73 68,74 65,75 64,78 63,75 60,74 63,73"/>
    <polygon points="60,86 60.5,88 62,88.5 60.5,89 60,91 59.5,89 58,88.5 59.5,88"/>
  </g>
</svg>
